project_name: Greek Law Firm Digital Accountant & Legal-Ops

theme_strategy.rationale: High-contrast 'Swiss Brutalist' light mode is preferable for reading dense financial/legal data and OCR receipts during the day. A dark mode toggle is available for power users in intensive accounting workflows.

rules: Use JetBrains Mono for ALL monetary values (VAT, Income, ΕΦΚΑ) to ensure tabular alignment.
No gradients for financial data backgrounds. Use solid flat colors.
Green for income/credits, Red for VAT due/debts/ΕΦΚΑ payables.
Color is for function only. Use monochrome base for structure.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use border-collapse logic for dashboards to make the data grid visible and highly structured. Max 4px (rounded-sm) border radius for all cards and inputs to keep it serious.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise on auth/login screens, purely solid for dashboard data areas to prevent visual refraction of financial figures.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use 1px borders instead of shadows to delineate cards.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_pattern: Modified F-Pattern Hierarchy. Place the 'North Star Metric' (e.g., Total VAT Due or Pending myDATA submissions) in the top-left quadrant.
grids_and_layouts.navigation: Collapsible Left-Sidebar. Required for complex European fintech stacks (Dashboard, Invoices, Expenses, myDATA, Payroll/ΕΦΚΑ).
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use h-full to stretch items.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align all numeric columns in tables EXCEPT the final amount which should be right-aligned. Left-align text.

component_rules.cards: Go cardless or flat rectangular. Avoid heavy drop-shadows. Use strict 1px borders (border-border).
component_rules.tables: Use Shadcn tables. Dense spacing (py-2). Must be screen-reader accessible.
component_rules.charts: Use Recharts. Use Waterfall charts for cash flow/VAT transitions. BANNED: Pie charts for financial data >5 segments. Use Bar charts for income vs expense.
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn Forms, Inputs, Select. Must have focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).
component_rules.toasts: Use Sonner for myDATA sync simulations and OCR success alerts. (Position: bottom-right)

motion.interactions: Hover states must darken backgrounds (hover:bg-muted) or elevate borders. Focus states must have high contrast rings.
motion.transitions: Fast and snappy. transition-colors duration-200. Do NOT use transition-all.
motion.loading: Use skeleton loaders (Shadcn Skeleton) for OCR processing and myDATA syncing.

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard. Ensure financial figures over any background have a minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='vat-due-amount').
accessibility.aria: Use aria-live regions for OCR parsing updates and voice command listening states.

receipt_ocr_sample.description: Close up of a receipt for the AI photo OCR mock/demo screen.

auth_background.description: Elegant justice scales/technology for the login/auth background.

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. Use provided URLs. Apply bg-black/40 overlay if placing text over the auth background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a comprehensive Dashboard with Left-Sidebar Navigation (Dashboard, Invoices, Expenses, myDATA, Payroll).
Dashboard must show Real-time VAT Due, Pending ΕΦΚΑ contributions, and Income/Expense summary.
Implement an 'Upload Receipt / AI OCR' module using the receipt_ocr_sample image, showing a simulated parsing state for Greek VAT (24%, 13%, 6%).
Implement a 'Voice Command' interaction button (e.g., 'Listening...') for invoice creation, simulating Whisper AI.
Create a 'myDATA Sync' panel simulating the AADE API connection (status indicators, sync buttons).
Design a Payroll/ΕΦΚΑ module showing gross-to-net calculations and tax brackets.
Ensure the layout is highly dense, cardless/flat bordered, using pure HTML/Tailwind for macro layouts and Shadcn for micro-components (Tables, Forms).
Add 'data-testid' to ALL critical numbers and action buttons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create a distinctive, precise, professional European legal/finance back-office tool.
DO NOT use Inter for headings. Use Chivo for headings, IBM Plex Sans for body, and JetBrains Mono for ALL monetary/financial figures.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns. Use backdrop-blur with solid/semi-solid backgrounds.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., 'transition: all'). Add transitions strictly for colors/opacity.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden). Keep text left-aligned.
DO NOT use AI assistant Emojis (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing (Tailwind p-6, p-8) around main page containers, but keep dashboard grid gaps tight (gap-4).
Always use the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder services.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
